subject: Integrated isolated S5 v8 route diverges on rocky slope before northwest fallback
scope: One isolated original-client 1.16.5.0 copied-server run from the archived post-Conrad-corpse character. Only the copied mission 1995 objective 1 timer anchor was reset. Ordinary client controls were used; no live or DIT change occurred.

exact_locations: output/driver-second-sandbag.log: final waypoint 11 entries through RuntimeError at waypoint 12

observations.finding: The v8 client followed the ordinary bridge and rock-slope route through waypoint 11 to (-170.72266,94.46094,-21.707031), yaw 5.310066, with about 382.65 seconds remaining on the reset copied timer. Its next target was (-180.004,92.568,-26.121).

observations.finding: The next forward hold produced accepted (-169.9336,95.265625,-23.414062), then (-169.42578,95.82031,-24.023438), both yaw 0.61646855. The driver measured target-distance changes of -0.150 m and -0.507 m. It stopped at waypoint 12 under its eight-second positive-progress guard, before the northwest route, fallback, higher-bank segment, or bomb use.
observations.source_location: output/driver-second-sandbag.log final RuntimeError; output/positions.tsv final rows

observations.finding: The last pre-hold focus screenshot shows the recruit on the rocky slope, with wreck terrain and sandbags visible farther ahead/right and 06:15 on the copied mission timer. It precedes the divergent accepted packets and does not establish a collider or original final-live route.

The earlier v3 successful client route began the analogous wreck-approach step from (-170.27344,94.78125,-21.8125), yaw 6.186545, and accepted (-172.76172,92.99609,-20.703125) toward the wreck. V8 began within about 0.46 m horizontally but with yaw about 0.88 radians different, then moved east/south away from its target. This supports a heading-sensitive controller divergence, not a proven terrain block.

observations.finding: The copied SQLite database passed integrity check. Mission 1995 and objective 1 remained active; objectives 2 and 3 were complete. No bomb interaction occurred.

The detached supervisor ended after 233.41 seconds after driver exit 1; copied launcher exit 0 and status.json recorded terminal client, Auth, Game and display processes. The diagnostic's atomic command publication showed no JSON parsing race in this run.

assessment.finding: The integrated northwest fallback was not exercised because the pre-sandbag controller stopped earlier. A grounded next local route test would use short, guarded heading corrections from the v8 slope point toward the v3 accepted first wreck-approach point (-172.76172,92.99609,-20.703125), checking fresh client Move, elevation and timer before resuming the far waypoint. It must be tested rather than assumed to reproduce v3.
